notes: Editable rulebook for the incident-report language guard. This is editorial risk-management practice, not legal advice — risk/counsel should confirm and tune these house rules. The guard flags and suggests; the reviewer decides. It never silently alters the reporter's words.
preserve_specificity_note: Neutral does not mean vague. Keep exact times, exact locations, observed conditions, first aid given, staff notified, and photo/CCTV references — they strengthen the report.

attribution.reason: Statement of an unwitnessed event in the property's voice. If staff did not personally witness it, the report should attribute it: 'the guest alleges/states/reports…' — the record then reports the claim rather than adopting it.

causation.reason: Cause-and-effect wording in the property's voice ('because', 'due to') reads as the property agreeing on the cause. State the allegation and the conditions actually observed instead.

fault_terms.reason: Fault/causation vocabulary in the property's voice can read as an admission. Replace with the specific condition actually observed (e.g. 'no bath mat was observed in the tub at the time of the report').

terms.failed to: Describe what records show was done: 'Records indicate the following steps were taken: …'
terms.negligent: Omit conclusions of negligence; describe only the observed facts.
terms.negligence: Omit conclusions of negligence; describe only the observed facts.
terms.unsafe: Describe the specific condition observed instead of labeling it unsafe.
terms.hazardous: Describe the specific condition observed instead of labeling it a hazard.
terms.hazard: Describe the specific condition observed instead of labeling it a hazard.
terms.dangerous: Describe the specific condition observed instead of labeling it dangerous.
terms.defective: State that the item was inspected and photographed; describe its observed condition.
terms.broken: State that the item was inspected and photographed; describe its observed condition.
terms.our fault: Omit — conclusions of liability do not belong in the factual record.
terms.at fault: Omit — conclusions of liability do not belong in the factual record.
terms.liable: Omit — conclusions of liability do not belong in the factual record.
terms.liability: Omit — conclusions of liability do not belong in the factual record.
terms.should have: Omit hindsight/speculation; state what was observed and what was done.
terms.obviously: Omit speculation; state only what was observed.
terms.clearly: Omit speculation; state only what was observed.
terms.responsible for: Omit — conclusions of responsibility do not belong in the factual record.

characterization.reason: Adjectives that characterize a person are conclusions. Record the observed behavior instead.

terms.drunk: e.g. 'Staff observed the guest stumbling and speaking loudly; the guest stated they had been drinking.'
terms.intoxicated: e.g. 'Staff observed the guest stumbling and speaking loudly; the guest stated they had been drinking.'
terms.wasted: Describe the observed behavior (gait, speech, statements) instead.
terms.careless: Describe the observed behavior instead of labeling the person.
terms.reckless: Describe the observed behavior instead of labeling the person.
terms.clumsy: Describe the observed behavior instead of labeling the person.
terms.crazy: Describe the observed behavior instead of labeling the person.
terms.aggressive: Describe the observed behavior (words used, actions taken) instead of labeling the person.

apology.reason: Apologies and promises to pay read as admissions of fault. Remove them from the factual record.

form_hints: Write what was observed and what the guest said — not why it happened.
If staff didn't see it happen, start with: 'The guest states/reports/alleges…'
Avoid: because, due to, unsafe, hazard, broken, defective, failed to, should have.
Keep the facts: exact time, exact location, conditions observed, first aid given, staff notified, photos/CCTV.
No apologies or promises to pay anywhere in the report.
Never give the guest a copy of this report or the form. If they want confirmation, give them the incident ID only - the claims administrator will contact them.
